title: Runtime configuration
originHelp: Enter exact HTTPS origins such as https://results.example.com, without paths or wildcards. An empty list denies all origins.
saved: Settings saved. Check “Currently in use” for activation.
saveError: Unable to save. Check the configuration; refresh and review if another administrator has changed it.
importDescription: Import is available when recently observed Workers agree. Review and explicitly activate; changes do not affect tasks before publication.
agentEffect: Model calls analyze and respond; tool calls perform actions. These settings allow up to {{steps}} model calls.
addOverride: Select a model service to override
downloadEffect: Unconfigured services inherit instance rules. Instance pause blocks every service; deployment emergency disable always applies.
activate: Start using these settings after saving
scopeEffect: After saving, new AI tasks and retries use the new limits; running and waiting tasks stay unchanged. Download rules apply from the next download without deployment changes.
observedHelp: Only reporting Workers are shown. Observations older than 90 seconds do not prove current activation.
loadError: Unable to read runtime configuration. Retry.
mixedSource: Some Workers have not switched to administrator policy
emergencyDisabled: Some Workers are disabled by the deployment emergency switch. Administrator settings cannot override it.
downloadPending: Processes have not yet reported reading the latest settings. Refresh runtime feedback shortly.
observedVersion: Observed Workers have read this version
importOnly: This only saves settings; current task behavior stays unchanged. Go back and select “Start using these settings after saving” to activate them.
inactiveInstanceSource: Runtime feedback conflicts with inactive settings
concurrentChange: A newer configuration was published. Your edits are preserved; loading the latest version replaces them.
invalidOrigins: Enter HTTPS origins without paths, parameters, credentials or wildcards.
activeRollbackOnly: After activation, rollback is available only to activated revisions.
editHelp: These are the settings to save. Review the differences before confirming.
noChanges: Settings are unchanged; only the reason will be recorded.
changedCount: {{count}} changed settings. Unchanged settings are omitted.
savedInactive: Saved settings are not enabled yet. The values below are not active shared limits.
feedbackUnknownHelp: No recent reports are available. This does not establish whether download rules are active and does not mean saving failed. Refreshes automatically every 30 seconds.
feedbackDetailsHelp: Processes with matching reports are grouped. Only reports from the last 90 seconds are considered; process count is not server count. Expired reports from earlier processes do not affect status. A report confirms a configuration read; each download still checks its policy.

feedbackState.mixed: Recent reports show different policy sources
feedbackState.inactive: Processes use administrator rules, but settings are not enabled
feedbackState.older: Some processes have not reported reading the latest version
feedbackState.current: {{count}} recently reporting processes have read the latest version

feedbackAction.deployment: Processes have not yet reported using administrator settings. Refresh shortly; if this persists, check that the service is running the updated version.
feedbackAction.mixed: Processes temporarily report different sources. Wait for the next report; if this persists, check for mixed service versions.
feedbackAction.inactive: Runtime feedback conflicts with inactive settings. Check service versions and current runtime status.
feedbackAction.older: Recent reports include an earlier revision. Wait for the next refresh; investigate processes if this persists.
